a real, documented limitation: convert already owns the literal 'convert *' pattern, so this phrasing routes to convert (then fails at runtime: dollars/euros aren't mathjs units), never to currency - currency answers to 'exchange' instead. This guards the routing decision itself against a future change that silently sends this phrasing to currency without also updating the README/CHANGELOG that describe the boundary.
